cases.sentence: Тогда царь позвал слугу. «Ах ты негодный ___!»
cases.translation: Then the king called the servant in. 'You wicked servant!'
cases.explain: Слуга is a predicate noun identifying who 'you' are, so it stands in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Их ангелы на небе всегда видят лицо моего небесного ___.
cases.translation: Their angels in heaven always see the face of my heavenly Father.
cases.explain: лицо кого (the face of whom) is a possessive relationship, so the noun goes into the genitive → Отца.

cases.sentence: Первым к царю привели того, кто был должен ему десять тысяч ___.
cases.translation: The first one brought to the king owed him ten thousand talents.
cases.explain: The numeral десять тысяч (ten thousand) requires the following noun in the genitive plural → талантов.

cases.sentence: Тогда Петр подошел к ___ и спросил, «Господи, сколько раз я должен прощать своего брата?»
cases.translation: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, 'Lord, how many times must I forgive my brother?'
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) takes the dative → Иисусу.

cases.sentence: Иисус подозвал маленького ___ и поставил его посреди них.
cases.translation: Jesus called a little child to himself and set him in the middle of them.
cases.explain: подозвал (called over) is transitive; for an animate masculine noun the accusative equals the genitive → ребёнка.

cases.sentence: Для него было бы лучше, если бы ему повесили на ___ мельничный жернов и утопили в море.
cases.translation: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck and he were drowned in the sea.
cases.explain: на with a verb of motion (повесили на — hung around) takes the accusative → шею.

cases.sentence: Лучше войти в жизнь калекой, чем с двумя ___ и двумя ногами быть брошенным в вечный огонь.
cases.translation: It is better to enter life crippled than, having two hands and two feet, to be thrown into the eternal fire.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → руками (instrumental plural).

cases.sentence: Тогда же ученики подошли к Иисусу и спросили, кто важнее всех в небесном ___?
cases.translation: Then the disciples came to Jesus and asked, who is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
cases.explain: в marking a location/status, not motion, takes the prepositional → царстве.

reading.ru: Иисус подозвал маленького ребенка и поставил его посреди них.
reading.question: What did Jesus do when the disciples asked who was greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
options: He called a little child and stood him among them
He named Peter as the greatest
reading.correct: He called a little child and stood him among them
reading.explain: Jesus called a little child to himself and set him among the disciples.

reading.ru: то для него было бы лучше, если бы ему повесили на шею мельничный жернов и утопили в море.
reading.question: What did Jesus say would be better for someone who causes a little one to stumble?
options: That a millstone be hung around his neck and he be drowned in the sea
That he be sent away from the town
That he pay a fine to the temple
reading.correct: That a millstone be hung around his neck and he be drowned in the sea
reading.explain: Jesus said it would be better for such a person to have a millstone hung on his neck and be drowned in the sea.

reading.ru: Лучше войти в жизнь калекой, чем с двумя руками и двумя ногами быть брошенным в вечный огонь.
reading.question: What does Jesus say is better than keeping both hands but being cast into eternal fire?
reading.explain: Jesus says it is better to enter life maimed than to be thrown into the eternal fire with both hands and feet.

reading.ru: Как вы думаете, если у человека есть сто овец, и одна из них заблудится, то разве он не оставит девяносто девять на холмах и не пойдет искать пропавшую?
reading.question: In the parable of the lost sheep, what does the shepherd do when one sheep goes astray?
options: He leaves the ninety-nine and goes to search for the lost one
He waits for the sheep to return on its own
He sells the flock and buys new sheep
reading.correct: He leaves the ninety-nine and goes to search for the lost one
reading.explain: The parable says the shepherd leaves the ninety-nine on the hills and goes to look for the one that strayed.

reading.ru: Если твой брат согрешил против тебя, то пойди и с глазу на глаз скажи ему, в чем он неправ.
reading.question: What is the first step Jesus recommends if a brother sins against you?
options: Go and tell him privately what he did wrong
reading.correct: Go and tell him privately what he did wrong
reading.explain: Jesus says to go and show him his fault, just between the two of you.

reading.ru: то тогда пусть он будет для тебя как язычник или как сборщик налогов.
reading.question: What should happen if the offending brother refuses to listen even to the church?
options: He should be treated like a pagan or tax collector
He should be forgiven without any further steps
He should be given a second chance in private again
He should be made a leader of the church
reading.correct: He should be treated like a pagan or tax collector
reading.explain: Jesus says if he refuses to listen to the church, he should be treated like a pagan or tax collector.

reading.ru: «Не семь, а семьдесят раз по семь».
reading.question: How many times did Jesus say Peter should forgive his brother?
options: Seventy times seven, not just seven
As many times as the brother apologizes in words
reading.correct: Seventy times seven, not just seven
reading.explain: Jesus answered Peter's question about forgiving seven times with 'not seven, but seventy times seven.'

reading.ru: то первым к нему привели того, кто был должен ему десять тысяч талантов.
reading.question: In the parable of the unforgiving servant, how much did the first servant owe the king?
reading.explain: The parable says the first servant brought to the king owed him ten thousand talents.

reading.ru: схватил его и начал душить. «Верни сейчас же все, что ты мне должен», — требовал он.
reading.question: What did the forgiven servant do to a fellow servant who owed him money?
options: He grabbed him by the throat and demanded immediate payment
He forgave the debt as the king had forgiven him
He gave him more time to pay
He reported him to the king right away
reading.correct: He grabbed him by the throat and demanded immediate payment
reading.explain: The forgiven servant seized his fellow servant by the throat and demanded he pay back what he owed.

reading.ru: Так и мой небесный отец поступит с вами, если не простите брата от всего сердца».
reading.question: What warning does Jesus give at the end of the parable of the unforgiving servant?
options: The heavenly Father will do the same to those who do not forgive their brother from the heart
The heavenly Father forgives everyone regardless
Servants who forgive will be punished
reading.correct: The heavenly Father will do the same to those who do not forgive their brother from the heart
reading.explain: Jesus warns that his heavenly Father will treat them the same way if they do not forgive their brother from the heart.
